sanitized_brief: Sample Civic Resilience Hackathon 2026. Tracks: Civic Data, Accessibility, Public Admin Tooling. Judging: technical implementation (high), real-world applicability (high), originality (medium), design/demo clarity (medium). Sponsor capabilities: managed DB, storage, serverless. Encourage open gov data. Blacklist: tutors, summarisers, wellness bots, opportunity navigators, crisis navigators, ops fatigue doctors. Prefer under-explored admin failure modes and allocation under constraint.
